source_message.text: Hi Tim — quick update: I don't have an Ingram account to verify this myself, so I've asked D2D directly what paper-thickness factor they're using, since it looks like Ingram's cream stock may just genuinely run thinner than Amazon's, which could explain the spine difference. (Unfortunately - D2D is slow in replying). I will check with some author FB groups to see if anyone knows. Very frustrating. Can we keep this job open another day or two? thanks! The upside is I know now to have 2 covers made. Didn't have this problem with book 1 :). In the meantime can you confirm the page count, font etc you used in the updated cover? Thx

items.title: Portable and Corruption-Free Text Rendering

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi Timothy,

I'll post on D2D's social media. maybe that will get a faster response.

However, there's a problem with your cover.

• The blurb edit and title font look good, both fixed correctly.
• One problem: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") is showing as garbled, corrupted text instead of the actual words.
• This looks like a font substitution or encoding issue — please check what font that text box is using.
• When you re-export, make sure the fonts are embedded or outlined/converted to curves so the text doesn't depend on font availability and renders correctly everywhere.
• Please fix and re-send .pdf first

Thx
C-

value_updates.rendering_requirement: Render the intended text correctly across viewers without depending on local font availability
value_updates.font_portability_method: Embed fonts or outline/convert them to curves when exporting
